chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Yaqtin, from his brother al-Husayn, from his father 'Ali ibn Yaqtin, from Abi al-Hasan عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who recites in the bathhouse and has intercourse in it. He said: “There is no problem with it.”

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no problem with it; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to recite and have intercourse in the bathhouse according to the Imam عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a ruling concerning two acts in the bathhouse: recitation and sexual intercourse. The Imam عليه السلام states that there is no objection to them, indicating their permissibility in this context.
